resources.title: NIST Reference on Constants, Units, and Uncertainty
resources.scope: Fundamental constants, SI units, uncertainty definitions, propagation, coverage factors, and reporting examples.
resources.expectedUse: Use the units and uncertainty sections to audit one worked numerical and one project measurement claim.

resources.title: NIST Uncertainty of Measurement Results
resources.scope: Type A and Type B evaluation, combined and expanded uncertainty, and example uncertainty statements.
resources.expectedUse: Read the basic, combining, and example sections; build a five-line uncertainty budget for a real or hypothetical measurement.

resources.title: BIPM SI Brochure
resources.scope: Authoritative International System of Units definitions, symbols, derived units, and practical-realization links.
resources.expectedUse: Check symbol, unit, dimension, and prefix conventions before formula or numerical practice.

resources.title: BIPM JCGM Guides in Metrology
resources.scope: Official GUM, Monte Carlo uncertainty supplement, conformity assessment, measurement models, and metrology vocabulary.
resources.expectedUse: Use the GUM introduction and one relevant supplement when a project uncertainty model exceeds simple independent propagation.

resources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database
resources.scope: Critically evaluated atomic energy levels, wavelengths, transition probabilities, ground states, and ionization energies.
resources.expectedUse: Look up one identified line and explain the transition, units, accuracy code, and why a database match alone is not a complete assignment.

resources.title: NIST X-ray Transition Energies Database
resources.scope: Searchable characteristic X-ray transition energies and wavelengths by element and transition.
resources.expectedUse: Use one transition lookup to practise EDS/XRF line identification, overlap, calibration, and uncertainty cautions.

resources.title: IAEA Radiation Protection Training Material
resources.scope: IAEA training packages covering radiation physics, quantities and units, interactions, detection, protection, quality control, and safety culture.
resources.expectedUse: Study conceptual physics, quantities, and safety doctrine only; facility procedures and authorized training remain controlling for real work.

resources.title: IAEA Live Chart of Nuclides
resources.scope: Evaluated nuclear structure and decay data, half-lives, decay modes, Q values, masses, binding energies, and selected cross sections.
resources.expectedUse: Trace one decay chain and identify which values are evaluated data rather than quantities to recall from memory.

resources.title: Particle Data Group
resources.scope: Current Review of Particle Physics, summary tables, particle listings, constants, and specialist review articles.
resources.expectedUse: Use a relevant review or summary table to verify a convention or value; record edition and section because the review is updated.

resources.title: NASA Space Flight: Application of Orbital Mechanics
resources.scope: College-level video primer on applying orbital mechanics to space flight.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Watch once, then reproduce the energy and transfer-orbit explanation without the video and state its simplifying assumptions.

resources.title: NASA NTRS: Orbital Mechanics and Spacecraft Attitudes
resources.scope: Public NASA technical presentation connecting two-body motion, perturbations, attitude frames, and on-orbit thermal environments.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Study the two-body and attitude-frame sections and explain why orbit alone does not determine surface thermal loading.

resources.title: ESA Earth Observation Training and Education
resources.scope: ESA Earth-observation MOOCs, tutorials, scientific toolbox training, and advanced thematic courses.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Choose one remote-sensing technique and summarize sensor, calibration, processing, validation, and uncertainty in a two-minute answer.

resources.title: ESA Orbital Mechanics
resources.scope: Short ESA instructional video introducing orbital-mechanics training context.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Use as a quick visual primer, then rely on the deep sheet and worked sources for derivation-level preparation.

resources.title: USGS: What Is Remote Sensing?
resources.scope: Official concise definition of remote sensing and examples of reflected/emitted radiation measurements and applications.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Build a 30-second definition that goes beyond satellite pictures and names measured radiation, platform, inference, and validation.

resources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
resources.scope: NASA systems-engineering processes, requirements, interfaces, verification, validation, technical management, and lifecycle thinking.
resources.expectedUse: Read the requirements and verification sections and map one project or payload claim to an objective acceptance test.

resources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook
resources.scope: Evaluated thermochemical, thermophysical, ionization, vibrational, mass, IR, and UV-visible reference data.
resources.expectedUse: Retrieve one property or spectrum, record phase/conditions/source, and explain why a reference value needs matched conditions.

resources.title: NIST X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Database
resources.scope: Critically evaluated photoelectron and Auger line positions, chemical shifts, splittings, and energy separations.
resources.expectedUse: Compare one candidate XPS assignment while explicitly checking charge referencing, overlap, line shape, surface history, and alternative states.

resources.title: IUCr Online Dictionary of Crystallography
resources.scope: IUCr-maintained crystallography hyperglossary with nomenclature and concept entries; International Tables remain more authoritative where they differ.
resources.expectedUse: Check three crystallographic terms and restate each with a physical example rather than memorizing wording alone.

resources.title: NASA Earth Observation Data Basics
resources.scope: Remote-sensing fundamentals, orbits, four resolution types, active/passive instruments, spectra, processing, and metadata.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Complete the resolution and processing sections, then explain why a digital number is not yet a physical retrieval.

resources.title: IAEA Nuclear Data Services
resources.scope: Official gateway for evaluated nuclear structure, decay, reaction, atomic, fusion, and plasma-material data services.
resources.expectedUse: Identify which evaluated dataset would verify a half-life, Q value, decay mode, or cross section instead of recalling a mutable number.

resources.title: NIST Special Publication 811: Guide for the Use of SI
resources.scope: SI writing, symbols, numerical values, conversion, and manuscript conventions, with a visible notice about its pre-2019 content.
resources.expectedUse: Use for notation and style while following the linked current BIPM SI Brochure for post-2019 definitions.

resources.title: NASA Basics of Space Flight: Trajectories
resources.scope: NASA learning chapter on trajectory geometry, conic orbits, energy, transfers, launch windows, and interplanetary flight concepts.
resources.topic: Orbital Mechanics, Spacecraft Systems, and Remote Sensing
resources.expectedUse: Read the conic and transfer sections, sketch one trajectory, and state frame, two-body assumptions, and practical perturbations.
